pkgmetadata.longdescription: Apache Solr is the popular, blazing-fast, open source search platform built on Apache Lucene. This ebuild installs the upstream binary distribution (the same artifact the official Apache Solr Docker image uses) under /usr/share/solr, with OpenRC and systemd integration.

use.flag: Install a systemd service unit for solr. Requires sys-apps/systemd on the host.
